market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from CPI-driven Fed hike expectations, oil at $108, and rising yields. Expect volatility into and after CPI print. Equity outflows likely to continue. Energy outperforms; rate-sensitive sectors underperform. Gold/silver may find support if CPI surprises hot.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural themes favor AI/semiconductor capex, copper/industrial metals scarcity, and energy transition. BRICS realignment and US-China trade friction create multipolar trade patterns. Inflation likely sticky above 3%, keeping rates elevated through 2027. Consumer spending remains constrained by energy and housing costs.
